environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in isolated VPC configuration. Subnet route table (rtb-0a3f8e2c) has local routes only (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry — no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints except logs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com (Interface endpoint with policy restricting to logs:PutLogEvents and logs:CreateLogStream only). Lambda reserved concurrency set to 3. IoT Core rule has basic ingest topic prefix ($aws/rules/) but no message-level throttling. Security group sg-0f4a2b8c9d allows no inbound, outbound restricted to 10.0.48.0/20 on port 443 only.
